searchChanges.before: Chaocipher (1918) — John F. Byrne's two-disk dynamic cipher that permutes both alphabets after every character. Algorithm kept secret for 92 years until the 2010 disclosure; never cryptanalytically broken.
searchChanges.after: Chaocipher (1918) — John F. Byrne's two-disk dynamic cipher. Disclosed in 2010; published known-plaintext and in-depth ciphertext-only attacks recover its keys.
